description: Source code for a driver module handling SPI flash memory (specifically SST25VF016B) within an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform. Implements read, write, erase, compare, and initialization functions, along with process and main functions for managing SPI communication and flash operations.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Init
methods.description: Initializes the flash driver, sets up SPI buffers, reads JEDEC ID, unlocks flash, and sets initial status.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Read
methods.description: Prepares a read job from flash memory, validating parameters and setting driver state.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Erase
methods.description: Prepares an erase job for a sector in flash memory, validating parameters and setting driver state.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Write
methods.description: Prepares a write job to flash memory, validating parameters and setting driver state.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Compare
methods.description: Prepares a compare job to verify flash contents against a buffer.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetJobResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the last job.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_MainFunction
methods.description: Processes ongoing SPI flash jobs, manages state machine, and handles completion or errors.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_ProcessJob
methods.description: Executes a step of the current SPI flash job, handling read, write, erase, and status checks.

methods.name: Fls_SST25XX_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of the driver module.
